title: Migrate build plugin to contract v2
goal: Adopt result_contract:2 in the build plugin: unconditional v2 result on every exit path, disposition on all branches, rc∈{0,1}, name-matched inputs from engine-resolved ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS, router budgets in manifest.

steps.description: Extend tests/build-test.sh with test cases that FAIL against the current implementation, covering every acceptance criterion: (a) result_contract:2 and disposition+reason present in build-summary.json on every exit path — pass (with files), scope_violation, incomplete/router_timeout, SIGINT, and missing-plan; (b) each valid_verdict (pass, scope_violation, incomplete, fail) driven through a dedicated test case and asserted in the summary; (c) grep-assertion that plugin.sh contains no hardcoded artifact path constructions (scope-manifest.md path joins, plan.json path joins); (d) assertion that build_stage_run reads scope_manifest and plan from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS when set. All existing tests must still run. Run the new tests and confirm they go RED for the right reasons before touching implementation.

Add `result_contract: 2` to the `provides:` block and a `router:` budget section (retries: 25, retry_on_exhaustion: 1) to the `config:` block in the manifest. The manifest already has valid_verdicts, primary:true on build_summary, provides.role, provides.events, name-matched inputs (no from:/path/type), and a cleanup hook — those stay unchanged.

Rewrite _build_write_build_summary in lib/summary.sh so EVERY branch sets build_disposition and build_reason before reaching jq: pass (with files changed) → disposition:complete, reason:build_complete; scope_violation → disposition:broken, reason:scope_violation; incomplete (router_timeout/error) → disposition:interrupted, reason:<terminated_reason>; inert_build → already sets disposition:broken (no change). Move result_contract:2 + disposition + reason from the conditional `+ (if $build_disposition != ...)` guard into the unconditional main jq object so they appear on every exit path. Preserve the existing `data.build_kind` conditional for non-pass detail.

Fix build_stage_run in plugin.sh to read scope_manifest and plan paths from ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (jq `.inputs.scope_manifest` / `.inputs.plan`) when that env var is set, falling back to the current hardcoded construction ($state_dir/scope-manifest.md, $artifacts_dir/plan.json) only when ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is absent (test-harness compat — _build_stage_run_inner continues to accept explicit path args unchanged). Fix the two rc∉{0,1} violations: (1) the missing-plan-json path (currently `return 2`) must call _build_write_build_summary with disposition:broken/reason:missing_plan_json then return 1; (2) the SIGINT path (`return 130`) must call _build_write_build_summary with disposition:interrupted/reason:sigint then return 1.

Run `npm test` (or `bash plugins/agent/build/tests/build-test.sh`) and confirm green. Run `bash scripts/check-coverage.sh` and confirm the 29% floor is not broken. Verify grep shows no hardcoded artifact path constructions remaining in plugin.sh. Confirm the before/after golden diff on the stage's own output is unchanged for a passing run. State the red step in the PR body per CLAUDE.md.

notes: 1. ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS fallback in step-4: build_stage_run is the public entry point called by the engine with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS set; _build_stage_run_inner accepts explicit paths and is called directly by unit tests — only build_stage_run changes. 2. The did_not_finish/SIGINT carve-out (#1208) expressed as disposition:interrupted is the regression guard for #1822 — the before/after golden diff test in step-1 must cover the interrupted path. 3. SIGINT return 1 (not 130) is safe because the engine's response table now drives retry policy from disposition; the rc value only signals fatal vs. non-fatal to the engine. 4. The scope_violation path in summary.sh today emits NO v2 fields (build_disposition is empty) — this is the primary defect step-3 fixes. 5. The cleanup hook (manifest + plugin.sh) is a confirmed no-op (#1705) and stays as-is — the hook exists for engine bracketing (#1705); removing it would violate a different invariant; a note in the PR body records this. 6. Router budget retries:25 matches the historic 25-iteration upper bound already cycle-clamped in plugin.sh; retry_on_exhaustion:1 follows plan plugin precedent.
